description: Course item C. After services leaves (course B), the TSL's logs and resolvers fields have ZERO broadcast consumers: olivine takes the typed seed; old-TSL recovery planning reads the object-storage bootstrap context; proxy log wiring rides the recover_from snapshot + layout/logs/ keyspace family; ResolverLayout.from_layout and monitoring_phase are director-internal and repoint at RecoveryAttempt. Delete both fields; the broadcast becomes {epoch, sequencer, proxies} - smaller than FDB's ServerDBInfo (which carries resolvers + logSystemConfig because SSes peek TLogs at runtime; Bedrock materializers get pull sources at unlock instead - named difference, justified). Coordinator replay/nil-clear semantics unchanged. TSLTypeValidator shrinks accordingly.
title: Broadcast reduced to its essence: {epoch, sequencer, proxies}
